title: Coffee, Lake Atitlán and the 48 Cantones
goal: Describe life around Lake Atitlán and the 48 Cantones, combining the passive with ser, reported speech and infinitive or que + subjunctive.
grammar: passive with ser, reported speech and infinitive vs que + subjunctive

sections.title: Coffee, Lake Atitlán and the 48 Cantones
body: In this lesson you read about Lake Atitlán, its coffee cooperatives and the 48 Cantones of Totonicapán, a community authority of K'iche' villages.
The grammar brings together three skills you know: the passive with *ser*, reported speech, and the choice between an infinitive and *que* + subjunctive from B2 Unit 4.

items: I can say who does or grows something with *ser* + participle + *por*.
I can report what the cantones or their representatives said, and cite them with *según*.
I can say who wants what with an infinitive (same person) or *que* + subjunctive (a different person).
